author: andrewgcodes
name: 11L MLP1024 seq2048 + val-only + sliding window + tuned Muon + int6(1-9) + LR=0.025
blurb: 11-layer transformer with MLP_HIDDEN=1024, seq_len=2048, val-only training (organizer-approved), sliding window eval (stride=64), tuned Muon optimizer (momentum=0.99, warmup from 0.92 over 1500 steps), aggressive int6 compression for layers 1-9 (9 of 11 layers), and optimized learning rate (0.025). 11L achieves sub-1.0 bpb (0.9953) while fitting under 16MB.
